title: Soleone Gaming
pitch: A release calendar for the games I'm watching, with hype ratings, scored reviews and an inline AI agent that finds release dates and cover art.
description: The agent runs in the editor on your own Pi login, reads official pages and proposes changes you accept or reject. Cover-led cards by month keep uncertain dates honest, and every review has spoiler tags and its own URL.

externals.name: Research agent
externals.note: The hosted calendar is read-only: the editor and the Pi research agent only run on a local dev server.
